committed_fraction_basis: design midpoint of the complete structural domain [0,1]; not an historical estimate

route_resource_cost.unit_definition: one resource-index unit per excess maritime lag week per model cargo unit
route_resource_cost.ocean_formula: route maritime lag weeks minus minimum route maritime lag weeks
route_resource_cost.handling_formula: zero differential because every declared route uses the same berth-yard-gate chain
route_resource_cost.trucking_formula: zero differential because every declared route uses one shared landbridge corridor stage
route_resource_cost.border_formula: zero differential: no frozen evidence supports a route-specific border increment
route_resource_cost.evidence_status: designed physical resource proxy; mandatory sensitivity analysis in 5.3.4

action.upper_bound_formula: one reference baseline service-capacity week at the controlled shared corridor
action.projection_scaling_formula: reciprocal of each formal block upper bound
action.direct_order_cost_formula: one queue-unit-week per model unit; readiness order and exercise are one eighth for the eight-week lead

behavior.exit_failure_cost_formula: one 21-week decision-horizon equivalent of the common resource index
behavior.route_market_cost_basis: no frozen route-specific market premium is identified in the public-data application

information.gamma_I_basis: upper endpoint of the formal credibility domain; frozen before training and reported as a designed reference case
information.waiting_error_scale_estimator: route-wise RMSE of one-step reference-wait forecast errors on the two held-out validation paths under Passive actions
information.public_signal_formula: maritime lag plus current route-stage workloads divided by action-adjusted effective capacities plus predetermined reference-share loading of released/adaptive decision mass and committed mass at berth
information.reference_forecast_formula: maritime lag plus current route-stage workloads divided by frozen base capacities before the current action
information.reference_loading_rule: official committed-itinerary reference shares allocate both committed mass and the adaptive decision pool for signal construction; the realised SUE is never used
information.credibility_clipping: clip the predetermined raw signal to reference forecast plus or minus gamma_I times the frozen route RMSE

capacity_technology.basis: unit-preserving one-period capacity technology; readiness stock persists until exercise and direct capacity is a one-period emergency service increment

physical_feedback.basis: designed reference feedback family declared in 5.1; the two-week window is the shortest nondegenerate lagged-share history

loss.waiting_cost_formula: vintage index plus one resource-index unit per model-unit week
loss.terminal_unit_cost_formula: same as the declared exit failure cost

mpc.horizon_basis: inherits the frozen 5.2.1 eight-week released lead forecast, equals readiness lead, and is no shorter than maximum reference maritime lag
mpc.scenario_construction_basis: three-point slow-central-fast support uses the two recovery endpoints and midpoint; released lead risk tilts readiness weights and observed serviceability tilts operational weights
mpc.terminal_value: formal terminal mass correction at the end of H_C

reactive_policy.release_formula: waiting/reference_capacity divided by one plus waiting/reference_capacity
reactive_policy.readiness_formula: released lead-risk probability times one minus current pressure response
reactive_policy.disclosure_formula: maximum of released current-risk belief and route overload response
reactive_policy.basis: dimensionless monotone current-state mapping with no future serviceability or event access

paths.maximum_final_count_basis: all 196 distinct contiguous 21-week blocks available from the 216-row frozen event-free residual library
paths.residual_sampling: deterministic without-replacement selection of contiguous 21-week blocks from the 216 unique event-free residuals; the original indexed candidate is retained when unique and duplicate candidates use a deterministic fallback; independent weekly resampling is forbidden because 5.2.1 detects dependence at lags 1 and 9

synthetic_calendar.basis: sentinel Monday calendars separate designed training and validation paths from the 2026 historical test event

designed_information.basis: training uses both probability endpoints and midpoint; validation uses the interleaved quartiles

designed_serviceability.recovery_rule: linear recovery from severity floor to one over all remaining weeks
designed_serviceability.basis: designed support spans endpoint, midpoint and interleaved validation severities without using the historical test outcome

training.sac_entropy_temperature_role: positive initial value; updated during every SAC episode rather than held fixed
training.sac_entropy_temperature_learning_rate_ba: same frozen optimizer step as the actor, avoiding an additional test-tuned learning-rate scale
training.sac_preprojection_policy: reparameterised diagonal Gaussian in latent space followed by the logistic action map
training.sac_projection_gradient: piecewise active-set subgradient of the unchanged formal convex projector away from active-set ties

computation.basis: independent path-policy replications use process isolation; two of 16 logical processors remain for orchestration and the operating system; production model, policies and random seeds are unchanged

state_and_actor.basis: complete-state linear actor with deterministic hash seeds; initialisation is frozen before validation and test replay

clearance.recovery_rule: zero demand, all master routes physically available, zero coordination action

numerics.sac_gradient_check_step_basis: cube root of IEEE-754 double machine epsilon for a central finite difference
numerics.sac_gradient_check_tolerance_basis: conservative multiple of the central-difference truncation and floating-point scale; numerical acceptance only

scientific_parameter_contract.rule: every result-affecting experiment design value is read from this frozen config or from a hash-locked input named by this config
